$comment: Shape of the file tools/identity_seed.php seed --file reads. Example values only: the real file names real NetIDs and campus groups, so it lives in reference\ (git-ignored), never in git. people sets the role on a NetID's user row; netids grants an access function to one NetID (app.AdminAccess); groups grants a role or an access function to every member of a campus group, spelled exactly as the proxy passes it in AUTH_GROUPS_HEADER. Roles: staff, coordinator, approver, admin. Functions: director, proxy, facilities, safety, fleet, equipment, inventory, it, finance, deputy, executive, studio. survey is a survey code; leave it out for every survey. A role never takes a survey.
